default.description: Core IPC for KEA's windows. Without a capability file at all, Tauri v2 resolves an empty ACL and rejects every `plugin:` command — which silently killed `listen()`, so no dictation, meeting or download event ever reached the frontend. KEA's own #[tauri::command]s are not ACL-gated (no app manifest), which is why the rest of the UI worked.
